Forrest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Headquarters Office Juneau, AK 99811-5526

Advisory Announcement

Released: 10:00 a.m. August 29, 2026

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

CONTACT: Geoff Spalinger, Area Biologist Brad Fuerst, Asst. Area Biologist Todd Anderson, Asst. Area Biologist (907) 486-1830

KODIAK COMMERCIAL SALMON FISHERY ADVISORY ANNOUNCEMENT # 44 For Emergency Order #4-FS-K-44-26

There will be a 24-hour extension to the current commercial salmon fishing period from 6:00 p.m. Saturday, August 29 to 6:00 p.m. Sunday, August 30 in the following areas:

-

The Cape Alitak, Alitak Bay, Moser Bay, and Olga Bay Sections of the Alitak District.

There will be a 96-hour extension to the current commercial salmon fishing period from 6:00 p.m. Saturday, August 29 to 6:00 p.m. Wednesday, September 2 in the following areas: The Outer Karluk Section of the Southwest Kodiak District; The Central, North Cape, and Inner Uganik Bay Sections of the Northwest Kodiak District; and, The Southwest Afognak Section of the Afognak District.

- - -

As Previously Announced: The following areas will close at 6:00 p.m. Saturday, August 29:

-

The Afognak District (except the Duck Bay, Izhut Bay, Outer Kitoi Bay, and Inner Kitoi Bay Sections remain closed, and the Southwest Afognak Section is extended until 6:00 p.m. Wednesday, September 2).

The following areas are scheduled to close at 6:00 p.m. Monday, August 31: The Outer Ayakulik Section of the Southwest Kodiak District; The Humpy-Deadman Section of the Alitak District; The Eastside Kodiak District; and, The Northeast Kodiak District.

- - - -

As Previously Announced: Fishermen are reminded that in the Kodiak Area (including the Mainland District) until further notice, Chinook (king) salmon 28 inches or greater in length may not be retained by purse seine gear in the commercial fishery and must be returned to the water unharmed.

Other closed waters are as shown on the Kodiak Area Salmon Statistical Chart and detailed in the Commercial Salmon Fishing Regulations (5AAC 18.350). Statistical Charts, Harvest Strategies, and Commercial Salmon Fishing Regulations are available at the Kodiak Fish and Game office. Recent salmon fishery information may be obtained by calling the Department’s 24-hour record-a-phone at 486-4559.
